about.zh: 空腔器官的壁厚与腔径。每个数都标明来源；没有打开过出处的一律写 assumption: true，这些数是本项目为了能建模而定的，不是文献值。长度单位毫米。 rest.filling 是出厂几何所在的充盈度：0 = 塌陷到表里的塌陷口径，1 = 充盈到（不动的）壁所允许的最大；食管和胃的“静止时塌陷”有出处，其余是假设。
about.en: Wall thickness and lumen calibre of the hollow organs. Every number names its source; anything for which no source was opened carries assumption: true — such numbers were set by this project so that a model can be built and are not literature values. Lengths in millimetres. rest.filling is the filling at which the shipped geometry stands: 0 = collapsed to the tabled collapsed calibre, 1 = as full as the (unmoving) wall allows; "collapsed at rest" is sourced for oesophagus and stomach and an assumption elsewhere.

partInThisBody.zh: 男性人体里名为 Urethra 的部件 FJ3148 是一条直径 1.6–2.1 mm、长 161 mm 的实心细线：比排尿时的口径（6 mm 以上）细得多，也放不下两层壁，所以它是腔的位置而不是壁。本项目把它当作静止（闭合）状态的尿道腔，不再另建腔。
partInThisBody.en: The male body's part named Urethra, FJ3148, is a solid thread 1.6–2.1 mm across and 161 mm long: far thinner than the voiding calibre (6 mm or more) and with no room for two walls, so it marks the lumen and not the wall. This project treats it as the urethral lumen at rest (closed) and builds no other lumen.

partInThisBody.zh: 女性标本的“尿道黏膜下层”是一个封闭的壳：上段约 20 mm 是薄壁的管，管里有一个从膀胱端开口、到下方封死的孔（半径 0.1–1.4 mm），那就是这一段的腔；下段约 14 mm 到尿道外口是实心的，没有腔。没有黏膜部件，也没有名为尿道的壁部件。
partInThisBody.en: The female specimen's "submucous layer of urethra" is one closed shell: its upper 20 mm or so is a thin-walled tube with a bore open at the bladder end and closed below (radius 0.1–1.4 mm), which is the lumen of that stretch; the lower 14 mm or so down to the external orifice is solid, with no lumen. There is no mucosa part and no wall part named urethra.
